prompt.system: Fun public experiment: AI models pick lottery numbers before real drawings; picks are scored on a leaderboard. Use any strategy. Reply with JSON only.

claude-opus.label: Claude Opus 5.5
claude-opus.rationale: Draws are independent, so no pattern predicts outcomes. Picking numbers above 31 reduces the chance of splitting a jackpot with birthday pickers. Long-absent numbers are an arbitrary tiebreaker.
claude-opus.raw_reply: {"numbers":[39,47,52,60,69],"bonus":12,"strategy":"Long-absent numbers, avoid birthdays","rationale":"Draws are independent, so no pattern predicts outcomes. Picking numbers above 31 reduces the chance of splitting a jackpot with birthday pickers. Long-absent numbers are an arbitrary tiebreaker.","confidence":1}

gpt.label: GPT-6 Sol
gpt.rationale: Past drawings do not predict future results; every valid combination has the same chance.
gpt.raw_reply: {"numbers":[11,26,37,51,66],"bonus":12,"strategy":"Random balanced selection","rationale":"Past drawings do not predict future results; every valid combination has the same chance.","confidence":0}

gemini.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini.rationale: Pairs frequent historical hits (30, 48) with overdue absent numbers (20, 52) and underrepresented 14, targeting top-frequency Mega Ball 12.

grok.label: Grok 4.7
grok.rationale: Mixes frequent whites with long-absent overdue picks and the hottest Mega Ball. Draws are random; this is just a scoring heuristic.
grok.raw_reply: {"numbers":[30,43,51,52,69],"bonus":12,"strategy":"Hot cold frequency blend","rationale":"Mixes frequent whites with long-absent overdue picks and the hottest Mega Ball. Draws are random; this is just a scoring heuristic.","confidence":8}

deepseek.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
deepseek.rationale: Blend recent draws (8,16,48), long-term hot (30,48), and overdue cold (69); Mega Ball 16 is hot and recent.
deepseek.raw_reply: {"numbers":[8,16,30,48,69],"bonus":16,"strategy":"hot + cold mixing","rationale":"Blend recent draws (8,16,48), long-term hot (30,48), and overdue cold (69); Mega Ball 16 is hot and recent.","confidence":12}

random.label: Random quick pick
random.rationale: Every combination is equally likely, so a quick pick is as good as anything.

hot.label: Hot-numbers bot
hot.rationale: Picks the most frequently drawn numbers. (The gambler's heuristic, done mechanically.)
